description: Redesign HomeView and the three data-entry views: PoultryView, LivestockView, ProductionView. Depends on FEAT-001 (CSS classes) and FEAT-002 (ui.tsx exports). Does NOT change any API call, state variable name, validation logic, or TypeScript type.
